title: Vignette 2026-10-30: AI should keep evolving clusters

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-10-30: "Some elements, like clusters, rarely need affirmation. These are dynamic. AI is good at this kind of thing. So I genuinely trust that AI will be better at building clusters than I will in many cases. I want AI to keep evolving clusters. Affirmation breaks the better version of the cycle."
